title: Great foam not hot enough
text: Great foam not hot enough. If it was getting my milk hot I would give it 5 stars but I have to nuke my milk for 2 minutes....

product_metadata.title: Milk frother for coffee，Electric milk frother and steamer, coffee frother electric,4 IN 1 Multifunction,milk steamer and warmer,Hot Cold foam Dense Airy foamer,matcha latte whisk frother
features: ☕Multifuntional electric frother for coffee✔One-Touch quadruple Function： Dense milk froth, Airy milk froth, Heated milk, or Cold froth. From milk to froth in a tap, it allows you to make creamy hot or cold milk frother for coffee.

☕Creamy and silky milk frother and steamer✔The thicker spring whisk of our electric milk frother is eccentric rotation designed， which can prevent the milk from centrifugal idling, so the milk is more fully whipped with air and evenly foamed. Then you can get the right texture, voluminous and stable microform, that luscious and silky mouthfeel we love in milk-forward coffee drinks.

☕Electric frother for coffee hot or cold is a smart designed✔360° Swivel base, Cordless jug, Non-stick interior, Removable whisk, Non-slip rubber feet together in this smart Milk Frother, which is exceptionally easy to clean. Automatic dual-speed motor and auto-switch off, It delivered a perfect temperature of the milk and its very quiet in full operation.

☕Compact and efficient milk foamer and warm milk steamer✔this compact and stylish milk foamer can holp up to 120ml(4.22oz) milk for hot/cold milk frothing or 250ml(8.80oz)for heating. Electric frother can heat up the milk to approx 150℉ meantime creating smooth warm milk froth in just 2 mins with the touch of a button in this warm milk frother.

☕Electric milk frother for milk With FCC, UL certifications are safe and reliable✔. Different kinds of foamer are perfect for making latté, cappuccino， macchiato， etc. The heating mode also helps you make a drink by mixing different tastes like hot chocolate, hot mocha milk, milkshakes, simply livening up coffee.

details.Recommended Uses For Product: For optimal milk froth, use refrigerated whole or low-fat milk (about 4-6 degress celsius)
